output.unit: % of dialysis center records in Harris County (21 of 149)
output.method: I downloaded the HIFLD Next dialysis-centers layer (7,772 national points) and the US county boundaries, and extracted Harris County (GEOID 48201), which contained 149 points. I then intersected those points with the Special Flood Hazard Area polygons (SFHA_TF = 'T') from the local FEMA NFHL S_FLD_HAZ_AR layer for 48201C, which matched 21 points, giving 21/149 = 14.09%. The dialysis file contains some duplicate-looking records at identical coordinates, which I did not deduplicate, so the figure is per record.
